notes: The patch notes are just words again. Some notes carried emphasis, and every panel escaped them before painting — so the tags turned up on screen as the literal characters instead of the sentence they were wrapped around. The emphatic words stay, the brackets are gone, and that holds for every note in the history, not only the new ones.
The same pass decodes the handful of named characters the notes use, so a dash is a dash instead of the name of a dash.

The settings tabs scroll properly now. The strip used to re-snap itself under your finger on a slow drag; it moves with the momentum your phone gives it and stays where you leave it, and the tab you open still glides to the centre.
Nothing else moved — the widget, the glass, the dial, the player and the library are exactly as they were.
